|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jakku: Niima Outpost Shipyard (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai-2022-01-07.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-Light8ba25cd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
